statement.zh: 祭祀坑青铜雕像/面具/神树等构成鲜明地方礼仪美术传统，与中原礼器组合并置但不等同。
statement.en: Pit bronzes (figures/masks/trees) form a distinctive local ritual art tradition juxtaposed with—but not identical to—Central Plains vessel sets.
